Helping Others to See
After the presentation, all three generations hang out together and discuss the way they can put into practice the values brought forth in the presentation.

A Ball to Roll Around
At Philadelphia’s Overbrook School for the Blind, I invented a successful variation of baseball. We called it groundball.
